accounts.emptyBody: Import a bank statement to see where your money goes.

auth.verifyBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth.verifyResend: No email? Check spam, or go back and sign up again for a new code.
auth.twoFactorBody: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
auth.recoveryBody: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each works once.

onboarding.totpBody: Scan this code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy...), then type the 6-digit code it shows. You need this before importing bank data.
onboarding.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
onboarding.recoveryBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. Store them somewhere safe: you won't see them again.
onboarding.passkeyBody: Sign in next time with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password and code. Your passkey stays on this device.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network_error: Can't reach SEWE. Check your connection.
errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Sign up again for a new one.
errors.code_attempts_exceeded: Too many wrong codes. Sign up again for a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.validation_error: Check the fields and try again.
errors.totp_invalid: That code isn't right. Wait for a new one and try again.
errors.recovery_code_invalid: That recovery code isn't valid or was already used.
errors.invalid_token: This sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.session_revoked: You were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.refresh_invalid: You were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.refresh_reused: For your safety you were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.passkey_challenge_invalid: That took too long. Try again.
